description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Refused with mirror_not_live or mirror_state_unknown when the mirror is not live or its state cannot be confirmed. Open an app: Home Screen, Spotlight via the menu, clear, type the name the way phone_type does (the clipboard keeps it), then tap only an exact label inside the Spotlight Top Hit card — or, where Spotlight shows its search field at the top and no Top Hit card, the exact label just under the field, and only when the field completes the name as "<name> — Open" — (suggestion, website and Settings rows of the same name are ignored, so a name the Top Hit card does not show is app not found, and one it shows at two or more spots is open_not_confirmed with nothing tapped; reads the English "Top Hit" label unless NORACU_TOPHIT_LABELS names the phone's own, and the "— Open" completion in English only; a name that never shows up in Spotlight after ⌘V, even after up to 15 s, is open_not_confirmed — retry; a one- or two-letter name such as "X" that OCR cannot read in the Top Hit card is open_not_confirmed without the 15 s wait, nothing tapped — open it from its Home Screen icon); confirms the app opened (frame diff + OCR), taps the Top Hit icon when the label tap does nothing, else open_not_confirmed, back on the Home Screen. If another app comes to the front before ⌘V: focus_lost, nothing pasted or tapped, no trip Home (Spotlight may stay open); if another app or device changes the clipboard before ⌘V: open_not_confirmed, nothing pasted or tapped, back on the Home Screen. Reports delivery and retry.
name: phone_open
